name: Leif
title: Lamp-boy of the First Lamp
examine: Twelve or near enough, chalk on both hands and oil on one sleeve. Counts everything he passes, out loud, and a barrow counts as a cart because it had a wheel.
lines: Three carts and a barrow. The barrow counts. It had a wheel and it had corn in it and it went in the ditch, so it counts.
Lamps out past the gate: two. I chalk it, she reads it, we disagree about the barrow, and then I walk back. That is the whole of my post.
The lamp stays lit. Hale says it and then he goes and does it, which is the part people leave out.
